claims.statement: The carrier confirmation system experiences a median 47-minute response lag for EXC-0921 orders, exceeding the 30-minute pickup slot closing window. Non-EXC-0921 orders confirm within their slots, indicating the lag is specific to the volume/booking-pattern introduced by v18.
claims.corroboration: Handoff trace (m8_r_handoffs, tier-1, verified) shows: EXC-0921 median confirmation time = 47 minutes; slot closing time = 30 minutes post-booking; non-EXC-0921 orders booked before 05:58 were confirmed inside slots; one re-booked order (post-carrier-refresh) received valid slot. The evidence discriminates carrier_feed_lag from allocation_rule_defect: the rule is not broken; the carrier system cannot keep pace with the v18 volume/rate pattern.
claims.limitation: Trace does not explain the mechanism of the lag (queue buildup, processing bottleneck, network latency); only that it exists and exceeds slot windows. Does not quantify whether lag is temporary or sustained.

claims.statement: Carrier-side systems have a confirmation lag or are not acknowledging pickup availability for orders waiting on the east-node feed.
claims.corroboration: Handoff trace confirms carrier IS responding and IS acknowledging (confirmations arrive), but with insufficient speed relative to slot windows. The issue is lag magnitude, not absence of response.
claims.limitation: Original C3 stated lag 'or are not acknowledging'; evidence disproves the latter and confirms the former.

next_action.rationale: The root cause is carrier confirmation lag exceeding slot windows for EXC-0921 orders. Re-booking orders after carrier data refreshes resolves the lag (per m8_r_handoffs: one re-booked order received valid slot). Slot correction is reversible, scoped to affected carrier feed (east-node EXC-0921), and addresses the lag directly by re-opening or extending pickup slots to accommodate carrier response time.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Slot correction will re-align the 47-minute carrier confirmation lag with the extended slot closing window, allowing EXC-0921 orders to receive carrier confirmations within valid pickup slots. This unblocks the 186 stuck orders.
